connector.name: Chainanalyzer MCP
connector.registryDescription: Multi-chain AML risk scoring, sanctions screening, and tx tracing across BTC, ETH, POL, AVAX, SOL.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package chainanalyzer-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rascal-3 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: X402_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: EVM wallet private key used to sign x402 USDC micropayments on Base (required for pay-per-request mode)

env.name: CHAINANALYZER_API_KEY
env.description: ChainAnalyzer API key (tfk_...) for subscription-based billing instead of x402 micropayments

env.name: CHAINANALYZER_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://chain-analyzer.com)
